Order 
This appeal by the appellant/claimant u/S. 173 (1) of the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 is arising out of the award dated 31.07.2009 passed by Second Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Morena (M.P.) (in short "Claims Tribunal") in Claim Case No.293/2008 on account of inadequacy of compensation and seeking enhancement of compensation.

entities.text: Second Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Morena
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. The date of accident, negligence and the issue of liability are not in dispute and the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal in this regard are not in question.

3. As per findings of the Claims Tribunal, in the case of injuries sustained by appellant/claimant in motor accident, an amount of compensation to the tune of Rs.98,000/- has been awarded by the Claims Tribunal with interest from filing of claim petition till its realization.
4. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that Claims Tribunal has committed grave error in awarding the amount.

He further submits that Claims Tribunal has awarded the compensation is on lower side and, hence, it is prayed NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2026:MPHC-GWL:371 2 MA-1353-2009 that compensation amount be enhanced and just and reasonable amount of compensation may be awarded.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the respondent No.2/insurance company contended that the amount awarded by the Claims Tribunal is just and proper and needs no enhancement.

He Mahaveer Sharma vs Keshav Singh on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/135622002/
1 supported the findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal and prays for dismissal of the appeal.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. After hearing learned counsel for the parties and perusal of the record as well as looking to the facts and circumstances of the case, more particularly the injuries sustained by him in the alleged accident, it would be appropriate to enhance to lump sum amount of Rs.3,00,000/-.
7. Accordingly, present appeal is allowed in part to the extent indicated herein above.
The amount of compensation is enhanced to lump sum amount of Rs.3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lac) in the present appeal.
The appellant is entitled to receive Rs.3,00,000/- in addition to the amount already awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
The enhanced amount shall carry interest as awarded by the Claims Tribunal.
All other findings recorded by the Claims Tribunal shall remain intact.
8. The present appeal stands disposed of.

(HIRDESH) JUDGE *VJ*
